notes.title: Update 1.0.9 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Hi,[/p][p][/p][p]two game-breaking issues which can just occur under rare circumstances reported by the community are fixed![/p][p]Patchnotes[/p][list][*][p]Fix: Buildingspot tile was placed on an enemy spawner tile[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Enemy spawners where placed unreachable[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Have a great weekend![/p][p]- Ronny[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.8 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Hi,[/p][p][/p][p]the new update fixes two game breaking issues players found! A hole on the summer map made it possible to go outside the map and another bug prevented some enemies to spawn during a night.[/p][p][/p][p]Patchnotes[/p][list][*][p]Fix: Nights could end before all enemies spawn[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Missing Tile Spawn in north-west corner of summer map[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Achievements fixed for curses and blessings already unlocked in demo[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I hope you enjoy the game![/p][p]- Ronny[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]First of all thank you for an amazing release date. I am overwhelmed by the feedback I got. 

There were some errors I address in this first patch[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fix: Hole in hex field after opening ogre chest[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Slider interaction in XP Main Menu Bar[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Steam Achievements not triggered when already achieved in demo[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Wrong amount of bones was given each morning for upgraded buildings[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you find more issues or have some feedback I look forward to it!

Best[/p][p]- Ronny[/p]
